title: Zoning text change for Sojourner Truth-Mapes site, Bronx
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area for the Sojourner Truth-Mapes Rezoning site in the Bronx. It was submitted by 2136 Crotona Parkway Housing Development Fund Corporation and covers Community District 6 in Council District 15.
